rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Did we make it through...?! Where's everyone..."
Touya: "We can't go back... So we're on our own from here..."
Ai: "It's all right. We've managed together all this time, haven't we?
We'll be all right this time too."
Touya: "Ai..."
Yamato: "A-ahem!"
Ai: "Oh, hahaha... Not just the two of us.
The three of us. Right."
Touya: "...All right! Let's go!"
Ai: "Yeah!"
Ai: "Is this the 'Core'...?"
Yamato: "It's ridiculously huge..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What the... Right into my head..."
Ai: "Touya, what's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Ai: "Hear what?"
Touya: "I see...
Someone's speaking directly into my head right now."
Ai: "Huh? What's that supposed to mean...?"
Voice: (At last, someone has made it this far...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, of course... How about this?
Does the voice sound more familiar now?)
Touya: (That's... Debish!?
You're still alive?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What's so funny?!)
Voice: (...No, forgive me.
Your thinking was simply so hasty.
It's true I was inside him once, but I am not him.
Let's see... You may think of me as something
like that Lin Karma person
who accompanied you.)
Touya: (Disembodied consciousness that can exist even after losing its body...)
Voice: (Something purer and more fundamental, actually.
In any case, you've done very well.
I never imagined that failure back then would lead to this result.)
Touya: (Back then... Don't tell me, 109 years ago...)
Voice: (Exactly. I thought it would go well...
Still, it brought forth a talent like you,
so perhaps it wasn't a mistake in the end.
They all did very well for me.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
Every one of them devoted themselves to me...)
Touya: (What the hell are you after?)
Voice: (...You humans of the Solar System really were
amusing creatures.
You can sacrifice your own kind without hesitation
for your desires, yet you also try to save them...
Fascinating.
I never tire of watching your actions.
What was the word for this...? Ah,
in your world, would you call it 'entertainment'?)
Touya: ('Entertainment'... You say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
Watching you struggle, suffer... And still stand against me.
Nothing surpasses the excitement
of a real battle with lives at stake... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why would you do that?!)
Voice: (Why? What an amusing question.
Because I'm bored, of course.
For those of us freed from the shackles of time,
who can even create the future,
everyday life is nothing but tedium.
That is why chosen beings like myself
amuse ourselves with games like this to pass the time.
Yes, with the loss of our own existence at stake.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
For something like that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever simply existed
within the aimless flow of time?
Nothing changes. The same time simply passes...
At first, I too thought that was natural.
I never even questioned it. But I was wrong.
When I observed humans living their fleeting lives
on distant worlds, far beyond our galaxy,
they brought a moment of fulfillment to my empty heart.
They showed me the radiance of life by risking their lives,
fighting, and winning. Only a very few
understood the exhilaration I felt.
But that hardly matters.
I am spending my time so richly now, after all.)
Touya: (I'll never forgive you... Playing with people's lives
just to pass the time... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good, that's it. Keep coming.
Humanity's future is in your hands now.
Or rather, in that Rayblade you pilot.)
Touya: (What do you mean?)
Voice: (Throughout recorded history, whenever humanity faced a crisis,
there was always something that could stop it, wasn't there?
Sometimes it was a person, sometimes a sword,
and sometimes an idea...
Something suited to the era saved humanity.
Have you never wondered
why something so convenient would happen?)
Touya: (D-don't tell me...)
Voice: (Yes, it was me. Those fools of Lin Karma
seem to have thought they sealed Vorlia away,
but I could have left that place whenever I wished.
I didn't simply because there was no need.
Above all, staying there kept them from interfering.
It was convenient for playing with you humans,
who only patch up appearances and never learn anything fundamental.
...And this time, that Rayblade is
the 'key' to saving humanity.
The only thing capable of stopping this Vorlia.
That's why you were able to come this far...)
Touya: (...But if we're still alive here,
doesn't that mean you lost in the past?)
Voice: (No. They failed. They couldn't even
reach me... And so, with their ambitions unfulfilled,
all of them were buried in history...)
Touya: (...Then I'll put an end to it this time.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager must
be fair, after all. If I keep myself somewhere safe,
I can't experience true enjoyment.
Suspense, you might call it.
It makes the enjoyment many times greater.
That's why I'm giving you this chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (If you use Rayblade to destroy this 'Core,'
neither Vorlia nor I will be able to sustain our existence. We will vanish.
And this world will be saved...
Hehehe... Now, may we begin?)
Touya: "..."
Ai: "...What is going on?"
Touya: "..."
Ai: "Hey, what's wrong? You're spacing out."
Touya: "...Huh? I was just talking..."
Ai: "Talking...? In these last few seconds?"
Touya: "...A few seconds...? I see..."
Voice: (Surprised? I can do things like this too.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a monster...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Well then, shall we begin...?)
Yamato: "M-meow, what's that?!"
Ai: "A black Rayblade..."
Touya: "...Let's go."
Ai: "Huh?"
Touya: "If we beat that thing, it'll all be over."
Ai: "I don't really get it, but okay."
Touya: "Sorry."
Ai: "Well, I guess that's what being in love does to you."
Voice: (...Hm? You're damaged...
It wouldn't be any fun unless you fought
in perfect condition... Very well.)
Ai: "What?! No way, the damage... It's repaired..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, entertain me!)
Touya: (Let's put an end to this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehehe... Very well.
Then end it all with your own hands...)
Touya: (I don't need you to tell me!)
Voice: (Good. You're proving quite entertaining...
But it seems this is as far as you go...
Well, I had some excellent pawns
to play with this time. It was quite enjoyable... But
it's time to say goodbye...)
Voice: (...So you fell short of my expectations...
You were doing so well until now...
Still, I had some excellent pawns
to play with this time. It was quite enjoyable... So
I'll erase you in an instant, without any suffering...)
Touya: "Damn......"
Ai: "Touya..."
Voice: (What?! I-impossible... You...!)
Kasumi: "Touya! Ai! Yamato!
Is everyone all right?!"
Touya: "Kasumi!"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're having a rough time."
Arthur: "Isn't it a little unfair
for you to take all the glory yourselves?"
Ai: "Everyone..."
Aurelie: "We managed to make it in time."
Fain: "Now that we're here, you can rest easy!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Melissa: "It really is better when we're all together."
Celica: "This is how a finale should be!"
Gen: "I'll look cool for the finale too!"
Melvi: "I'm here too!"
Voice: (Why... How could you break through that barrier...?)
Rayfon: (You shouldn't underestimate the people of this world.
These humans who have established their 'individuality.'
Each one's strength is small, but when they join together,
they produce more power than you'd expect...
That is what sets these humans apart.
Because they aren't perfect, they try to make up for it
by cooperating with others. That gives rise
to an unpredictable power that numbers cannot explain.
Trust, friendship, love... It takes many forms.
Do you know its name?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (Its name... is 'bonds.'
You believe only in yourselves. You trust no one.
No one relies on you, and you love no one.
So I doubt you could understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Fascinating. More and more fascinating!
Very well! I shall grant you all the right
to take part in this wager!)
Voice: (...!? Why?! Why won't they come forth?!)
Rishuna: (It's no use. I've sealed off this space.
You can no longer summon anything.)
Voice: (Damn...)
Valga: (It's about time we brought this to an end.)
Voice: (It seems... I underestimated you a little...
But I can also do this...)
Clovis: "What?! What's going on...?"
Arthur: "Illusions...? No, that's not it..."
Xiujian: "...So our final enemy is ourselves..."
Voice: (Now, let the delightful festivities begin!!)
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "Hm?"
Touya: "I'll keep my promise. Keep your schedule open."
Ai: "...Of course.
We're going to win, Touya..."
Touya: "Yeah."
Clovis: "Th-this is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Celica: "I can't believe it..."
Touya: "...Let's go!!"
Ai: "Everyone!"
Kasumi: "Touya! Ai!"
Clovis: "Are you both all right?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...It looks like the battle is decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here too, you know..."
Voice: (...Splendid... You've given me quite a lot of enjoyment...)
Touya: (This is the end.)
Voice: (Hehehehehe... Yes...
But this doesn't mean everything is over...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I will indeed disappear.
But unless you make the Core cease to exist,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...That was quite enjoyable...
Experiencing destruction isn't so bad... is it...)
Touya: (W-wait! How do I make the Core cease to exist?!)
Voice: (...I told you Rayblade was the key...
You'll have to work out what to do yourself...)
Touya: (The key... Myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... It's a pity I won't be able
to see it through to the end, but I wish you luck... Farewell...)
Touya: "..."
Ai: "...Touya?"
Touya: "O-oh... Sorry."
Ai: "...What's wrong?
You don't look like it's all over."
Touya: "...N-nothing..."
Touya: "...H-hey, sit down properly... Ow, ow, ow!"
Ai: "Is this the mouth that's telling lies?"
Touya: "I'm not lying..."
Touya: "Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow..."
Ai: "...Listen, Touya.
I don't know what you were talking about,
but I'm with you to the end. Don't forget that."
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "...So don't hesitate. I'm right here beside you."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ai: "Huh? Wh-what...?"
Yamato: "Is Vorlia moving?
What in the meow...?"
Touya: "...Tch, it won't even give me time to think..."
Touya: "...Hear me out."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you switching to transmit mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Ai: "...Let's leave him be."
Yamato: "Huh?"
Ai: "...Let him do what he wants. Trust Touya."
Yamato: "O-okay..."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core.
But this Rayblade is the only thing that can do it.
So I want you to head back ahead of us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell do you mean?!"
Touya: "...I know it's selfish
to say this after we've come so far.
But it's not that I don't believe in you.
I want you to go back because I believe in you, because I trust you.
And let me feel safe knowing I have somewhere to return to,
somewhere I have to return to..."
Ai: "Touya..."
Clovis: "Hey, you can't say that after we've come all this way.
We're sticking with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... Do you think we'll meekly obey
just because you tell us to go back? I haven't sunk so low
that I'd leave everything to a comrade and walk away alone."
Arthur: "How cold... I'll accompany you to the very end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'm sticking with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We should face reality calmly.
There's nothing we can do as we are now.
It's frustrating... But it's the truth.
So we shouldn't make this any harder for him.
If we truly believe in him, if we're truly his comrades,
we should leave this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you must keep
your promise to return."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll try."
Clovis: "Touya... No, never mind.
It's only a short goodbye."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "......I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say farewell."
Touya: "Yeah. Neither will I."
Arthur: "...Be careful..."
Fain: "......Damn!"
Touya: "I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Fain: "...A-all right! But don't you dare die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Touya... I'll be waiting.
So I won't say goodbye..."
Touya: "Yeah. I'll be back in a bit."
Kasumi: "Okay. I understand.
...Ai... Take care of Touya for me."
Ai: "Kasumi..."
Kasumi: "Do your best."
Ai: "...Yeah! You too, Kasumi!"
Kasumi: "Hehehe... See you, then."
Touya: "...Well then, let's go."
Yamato: "Go...?"
Ai: "...You're going to use Rayblade itself."
Touya: "Oh, you really do get it."
Ai: "It's just the sort of thing you'd think of.
But... Rayblade will be destroyed."
Touya: "You don't think we'll fail?"
Ai: "Not at all. No enemy can stand
before the power of our lovey-dovey love!"
Touya: "...Yeah, that's right."
Ai: "...Hey, Touya."
Touya: "Hm?"
Ai: "Can I... come over there?"
Touya: "Huh? But what about piloting...?"
Ai: "We aren't fighting, and there's nothing left for me to do.
Besides... The way we are now, I'm sure this mech
will move just fine... Come on, can I?"
Touya: "..."
Ai: "Yes! ...There we go.
...Ehehehe, it's a little cramped."
Ai: "It's all right. We've always found a way, haven't we?
This time will be easy too!"
Touya: "...You're so carefree."
Ai: "Well, that's my selling point!"
Touya: "..."
Touya: "...Shall we go...?"
Ai: "...It's a little scary."
Touya: "It's all right. We'll always be together.
...Here we go."
Ai: "Yeah!"
Touya: "Uooooooooh!!"
Ai: "Gooooo!"

review_batches.context: Read all 357 rows plus s_031's Vorlia setup and the separately routed nearby members. Ai-route finale: Touya/Ai/Yamato enter alone, Core appears, a concealed Voice speaks only to Touya and changes its voice to Debish's; it explains its pastime and past influence.
review_batches.decisions: Keep source Voice label rather than inserting a later/library identity. All telepathic turns retain parentheses, spoken exchanges retain quotes. Its claims about occupying Debish, disembodied existence, 109 years, creating futures and humanity's role are attributed speech, not narrator fact. Core here is Vorlia's central component, distinct from the scarce power-source material and generic mech names. Yamato corrects the two-person count to three; do not erase her.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Voice claims history's saviors were its game pieces, Rayblade is the sole key and it risks its own existence; Ai notes only seconds passed, black Rayblade appears and damage is restored before alternate combat events.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve Touya's challenge and the Voice's claim that earlier challengers failed; do not simplify into confirmed past victories by either side. Core-destruction conditions are its explanation, not proved engine mechanics. Ai cannot hear the full telepathic exchange. Healing refers to mech damage in this battle context; no medical cure or real-time ratio is invented. Its unfair-game boasting is not approved or softened.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Alternate failure taunts, team arrival, Rayfon's bonds rebuttal, Rishuna's spatial block and mirrored-enemy setup; promises, apparent victory and Voice's final warning about the still-active Core.
review_batches.decisions: Keep separate failure/success-triggered events rather than one chronology. Every arriving ally and Yamato's overlooked-presence gag remain. Rayfon's account of cooperation is his argument, not numeric damage mechanics. Rishuna's block is local and claimed, no universal summoning cutoff. Don't name the unnamed summoned beings or identify copies as mere illusions after Arthur rejects that. Voice defeat does not equal Core destruction.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Voice departs without supplying the solution, Ai insists on staying, Vorlia moves, Touya broadcasts a withdrawal request and allies resist before Rayfon urges trust; individual farewells continue.
review_batches.decisions: Keep ignorance of the solution, no invented physical cheek-pulling choreography beyond mouth joke/pain. Touya requests others return so he has a place to come home to, not because he distrusts them. Resolve aid direction explicitly in repeated entrustments. Returning alive remains a promise and effort, not guaranteed survival or confirmed death.
